title: Graph-free proper/open comparison for a pulled-back compactification
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring and a:V→X, p:V→U, f:X→Y, j:U→Y a cartesian square, with a and j open immersions. For a supplied compactification c of f, define P(c):R(p)_!(c.ofIsPullback sq) ⋙ Dj! ≅ Da! ⋙ R(f)_!(c) by the proper/open exchange for the proper part c.g, followed by the open-composition comparison using (c.ofIsPullback sq).i ≫ fst = a ≫ c.i. It is precisely the tail of E(c,b) from [def-asd-open-support-compactification-model], after its graph comparison. Use compactifications and unbounded functors of [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. There is no quasi-compactness hypothesis and no choice of an isomorphism.

def openSupportPullbackIso
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X Y U V : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {j : U ⟶ Y} [IsOpenImmersion j] {a : V ⟶ X} [IsOpenImmersion a]
    {p : V ⟶ U} (sq : IsPullback a p f j) (cf : Compactification f) :
    Rf_!(cf.ofIsPullback sq)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ] ⋙
        D((j)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]) ≅
      D((a)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]) ⋙ Rf_!(cf)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]
